translations.web: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
translations.bsb: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, for their fathers treated the false prophets in the same way.
translations.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
translations.asv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for in the same manner did their fathers to the false prophets.
